message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, new traffic rules come into effect allowing suspension, cancellation, or non-renewal of driving licenses in 12 cases including health problems.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,4,5,6]},{"claim":"Health authorities are obligated to provide data on drivers with diseases affecting driving safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,7]},{"claim":"Drivers with licenses expired for more than 10 years must pass theoretical and practical exams to renew.","supported":true,"evidence":[8]},{"claim":"Vision requirements have been introduced for different driver categories, including acceptance of eye exam results from abroad.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13,14]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) introduced four new fourth-generation traditional abras.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The abras correspond to the latest technical standards.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,5]},{"claim":"Each abra accommodates 24 passengers.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Each abra is equipped with modern systems, including digital screens with real-time information.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6]},{"claim":"This marine transport expansion aims to improve comfort, safety, and accessibility of transportation.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3,4,5]},{"claim":"The expansion also aims to integrate marine transport with other transport modes in the emirate.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Municipality announced the opening of registration for the fifth season of Souk Al Freej with 50 free stalls.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The event will take place in three parks from 11 December 2026 to 17 January 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"The market will start at Nad Al Sheba Rose Garden, then move to Al Barsha Pond Park, and conclude at Al Warqa Park.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"The program includes products from local entrepreneurs, cultural zones, and entertainment for the whole family.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,9,10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai's Emaar-managed residential complexes, fireworks are banned during Diwali celebrations.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The ban on fireworks is introduced according to local regulations to ensure residents' safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Residents are advised to follow safety precautions when lighting candles and diyas at home: keep them away from flammable materials, do not leave them unattended, and do not use them in common areas.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"Emaar Community Management wished everyone a safe and happy Diwali.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, 2027, in the UAE, children up to 4 years old must travel in child safety seats installed on the rear seats.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5,6]},{"claim":"The child seats must correspond to the child's age and weight according to approved standards.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Exceptions are provided for children with medical conditions and vehicles without rear seats, where the seat can be installed facing backwards on the front seat with the airbag deactivated.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8,9,10]},{"claim":"Children older than 10 years or at least 145 cm tall may occupy the front passenger seat.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,14]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Police launched a traffic safety awareness competition.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The competition is on the Traffic Safety Platform.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,13]},{"claim":"The competition aims to raise awareness about causes of traffic accidents and safe road behavior.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"The competition will last five weeks.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The competition includes 10 questions about main causes of accidents such as failing to keep safe distance and speeding.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Winners will be selected by electronic draw.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Winners will receive an Esaad card with privileges and discounts.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]},{"claim":"Participants can register at https://amanroads.gov.ae/trsp/en to participate and get safety advice.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,14]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In the UAE, the employer is obliged to issue a job experience certificate upon termination or contract expiration.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"The certificate includes dates of employment, job title, salary, and reason for termination.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11,13,14,15]},{"claim":"MOHRE simplifies obtaining the certificate online via website or app.","supported":true,"evidence":[17,18,19,20,21,22,23,24]},{"claim":"The certificate is valid for 30 days and can be verified through an authenticity check service.","supported":true,"evidence":[25]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Выпускники зарубежных университетов, входящих в топ-100 мирового рейтинга, могут претендовать на 10-летнюю Золотую визу в ОАЭ.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,8,25]},{"claim":"Средний балл выпускника должен быть не ниже 3.5.","supported":true,"evidence":[9]},{"claim":"С момента выпуска должно пройти не более двух лет.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"Для подачи заявки необходимо сначала получить одобрение номинации через ГДРФА в Дубае или Федеральный орган по вопросам гражданства и иммиграции в других эмиратах.","supported":true,"evidence":[18,19,21,22]},{"claim":"Виза позволяет спонсировать семью при наличии работы и жилья.","supported":true,"evidence":[26]},{"claim":"После окончания срока визы требуется сменить статус на другой, например, рабочий или инвесторский.","supported":true,"evidence":[27,28]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, a 1650-meter tunnel on Al Khaleej Street has been opened.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"The tunnel connects the Deira district with the intersection of Al Khaleej Street and Al Wuheida Street.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The tunnel has three lanes in each direction and a capacity of 12,000 vehicles per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The tunnel is part of the Al Shindagha Corridor Development Project, which will improve transport connectivity and reduce travel time in the area to 16 minutes by 2030.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4,5]},{"claim":"The tunnel decoration uses a mosaic of 35 million pieces created by artist Maryam Al Hathboor.","supported":true,"evidence":[8] }]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Municipality introduced the first fully electric vehicle for the collection and transport of general waste.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The vehicle operates on three lithium-ion batteries.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The vehicle can travel up to 150 km on a single charge.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"The vehicle has a waste storage capacity of 19 cubic meters.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"The vehicle has a load capacity of up to 11 tonnes.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Fast charging allows the battery charge to increase from 20% to 80% in 1 hour 45 minutes.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"The vehicle is equipped with a camera system for safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[8]},{"claim":"The vehicle supports different container sizes.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]},{"claim":"This initiative is part of a strategy to reduce waste and transition to environmentally friendly technologies in the city.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"UAE officially approved a new oral treatment for vitiligo.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,3,10,11]},{"claim":"Vitiligo is a chronic skin disease associated with an autoimmune disorder.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]},{"claim":"The UAE is the first country in the world to approve this therapy.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The treatment is available by prescription and prescribed by specialists in immunological diseases.","supported":true,"evidence":[11]},{"claim":"The launch coincided with the 10th Annual Dermatology Conference in Dubai, where latest dermatology advances and innovative treatments were discussed.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,15,17,18]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"A 110-metre pedestrian bridge will open in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The bridge connects Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall Metro Station with Coca-Cola Arena in City Walk.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The bridge has a capacity of approximately 10,000 people per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[11]},{"claim":"The bridge will improve pedestrian safety and convenience.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,10,12,15]},{"claim":"The project is part of RTA's plan to develop pedestrian infrastructure and reduce pedestrian traffic accidents.","supported":true,"evidence":[16,18,19,20]},{"claim":"The bridge will help reduce road traffic congestion and improve comfort for visitors to major events at the arena.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13,15]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Ministry of Interior of the UAE postponed the limit on the number of vehicles residents may license.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The postponement is pending the completion of a review and approval of appropriate regulatory requirements.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The review will consider the rights of vehicle owners, the needs of families and investors, and how vehicles are used, including classic, rare and luxury vehicles.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 2027, all rental cars in the UAE must be equipped with tracking devices.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4]},{"claim":"Companies must obtain a rental permit valid for one year.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"The permit requires installation of approved tracking devices and registration on a unified electronic platform.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"There are requirements to verify renters' driving licenses and to electronically register rental agreements.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]},{"claim":"Rental of private cars without a license for this activity is prohibited.","supported":true,"evidence":[12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Paid parking will be introduced in Abu Dhabi's Musaffah sectors M10 and M17 from 16 November 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"In the fourth phase of the paid parking system expansion, 4,233 parking spaces will be activated in Musaffah, with 1,645 in sector M10 and 2,588 in sector M17.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"The cost of a standard parking space will be 2 dirhams per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[9]},{"claim":"Paid parking will help regulate the use of public parking, reduce congestion, and improve traffic flow in one of Abu Dhabi's major industrial and commercial areas.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,7]},{"claim":"Payment for parking is possible through the Darb and TAMM apps.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае утвердили план развития общественных услуг и инфраструктуры до 2040 года с бюджетом в AED9.59 млрд.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,17]},{"claim":"Одобрен проект продления метро до города аэропорта Аль-Мактум с бюджетом AED2 млрд.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,18]},{"claim":"Продление метро создаст 3-километровый маршрут с двумя новыми станциями, соединяющими маршрут 2020 с аэропортом.","supported":true,"evidence":[18]},{"claim":"Открытие продления метро запланировано на 2031 год.","supported":true,"evidence":[18]},{"claim":"План предусматривает развитие объектов безопасности, здравоохранения, образования и спорта, а также улучшение условий для пожилых и семейных мероприятий.","supported":true,"evidence":[17,18]},{"claim":"Исследование рынка недвижимости поддержит стратегию развития сектора до 2033 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[19,20]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Residents of 22 Dubai Residential communities can split rent payments into smaller parts instead of paying a large sum upfront.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,4]},{"claim":"The new scheme is available to new tenants and those renewing their leases.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Dubai Residential's portfolio includes over 146,000 residents and communities such as Bluewaters, City Walk, and Nad Al Sheba Villas.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4]},{"claim":"Payment can be made using credit cards from some banks, with terms and fees depending on Rentify.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"This scheme allows tenants to better manage expenses by splitting the first quarterly rent payment into smaller installments.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3,5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае запущена новая инициатива, позволяющая получать разрешения на строительство мечетей в течение пяти дней.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Процесс упрощён для учёта основных и эксплуатационных потребностей мечетей и их объектов.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,8]},{"claim":"Инициатива охватывает строительство, модификации, расширения и техническое обслуживание мечетей.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Работы без структурных изменений освобождены от необходимости получения разрешений.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Координация между муниципалитетом и департаментом исламских дел позволит ускорить рассмотрение проектов и оценку технических требований на ранних этапах.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Nakheel представил жилой проект Palm Springs в южном Дубае","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Компания Nakheel объявила о запуске Palm Springs — жилого комплекса площадью 3,8 млн кв.м рядом с Palm Jebel Ali","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Проект рассчитан на почти 50 000 жителей и включает 15 районов","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"В Palm Springs будут виллы, таунхаусы, квартиры, школы, больница, шесть мечетей, спортивный и загородный клубы, а также торговые и культурные объекты","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Проект получил LEED Platinum Precertification за экологичные решения по воде, энергии и отходам","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Планируется около 593 000 кв.м открытых пространств с парками и более 35 км маршрутов для прогулок и спорта, соединяющих районы с инфраструктурой","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Время прохождения паспортного контроля в аэропорту Дубая сократили до 3,4 секунды","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2,4,5]},{"claim":"В аэропорту Дубая внедрили обновленную систему умных ворот, которая позволяет зарегистрированным пассажирам проходить иммиграционный контроль всего за 3,4 секунды","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,4,5]},{"claim":"Технология использует биометрические данные, зарегистрированные при регистрации на рейс, чтобы ускорить проверку личности и сделать перемещение по аэропорту более удобным и быстрым","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3]},{"claim":"Система помогает снизить очереди и улучшить координацию служб в аэропорту","supported":true,"evidence":[3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Amazon стал первым онлайн-ритейлером на платформе Essential Goods Prices.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,11,19,27]},{"claim":"Министерство экономики и туризма ОАЭ и Amazon UAE подписали меморандум о сотрудничестве для повышения прозрачности цен и поддержки умных покупок.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,5,9,10]},{"claim":"Теперь покупатели могут сравнивать цены на товары первой необходимости в 12 крупных магазинах и на Amazon.ae в одном месте.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,27]},{"claim":"Платформа отображает цены в реальном времени по 33 категориям товаров, включая 17 основных потребительских и 16 ключевых товаров.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,26]},{"claim":"Это первый случай интеграции онлайн-ритейлера в платформу, что расширяет возможности для сравнения цен между физическими и интернет-магазинами.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,11]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Ras Al Khaimah reopened seven public and resort beaches after nearly three weeks of closure due to oil spill concerns.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The reopened beaches include Flamingo Beach, Dahan Beach, Al Maireedh Beach, and Al Rams Corniche.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Beaches at three major resorts were also reopened.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The beach closures were ordered on October 24 as a precautionary measure after an oil spill from a tanker.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The oil leak was stopped on October 30, pollution declined, and cleanup and monitoring operations continue.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Authorities urge compliance with safety instructions and monitoring of official announcements.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В районе Аль-Фурджан в Дубае установлены платные парковочные зоны с кодом 591P.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Оплата действует с 8:00 до полуночи.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Доступна почасовая оплата и подписки.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Стоимость подписок: месяц — 672 дирхама, год — 4999 дирхамов.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Оплатить парковку можно через приложение Parkin, где также указаны тарифы и зоны.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"New UAE traffic regulations tighten vehicle recall and inspection rules starting from January 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Commercial agents are required to repair manufacturing defects free of charge.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,10]},{"claim":"Commercial agents must inform vehicle owners about recalls.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5]},{"claim":"Authorities can suspend transactions involving vehicles whose owners do not respond to recall notices.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,7,8,9]},{"claim":"New requirements are introduced for technical inspection and updating vehicle owner data.","supported":true,"evidence":[12,13,14,15,16]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the Russian post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Banks in the UAE began notifying customers about changes in service terms and tariffs effective from the beginning of 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4,5,11]},{"claim":"The new terms cover accounts, credit cards, loans, and digital services including the use of facial recognition for transaction verification.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,8]},{"claim":"Customers are advised to carefully review notices, especially sections on fees, digital authentication, and data use.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,7,8,15]},{"claim":"The changes do not necessarily mean a mandatory increase in all tariffs; some updates concern only wording and procedures.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"KHDA представила единый каркас безопасности для частных учебных заведений, включая школы, детские центры и вузы.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,3]},{"claim":"В системе выделены три уровня риска угроз безопасности учащихся с разными процедурами реагирования.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,19,26]},{"claim":"В каждой школе создадут команду защиты, в которую войдут директор и минимум два ответственных сотрудника.","supported":true,"evidence":[13,14]},{"claim":"Они будут следить за случаями, координировать действия и взаимодействовать с властями.","supported":true,"evidence":[14,15,16,20,21]},{"claim":"Каркас основан на законе о правах ребёнка и поддерживает стратегию образования Дубая до 2033 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[10,11]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"2 и 3 декабря 2026 объявлены выходными в частном секторе ОАЭ","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Министерство человеческих ресурсов и эмиграции объявило, что среда и четверг, 2 и 3 декабря 2026 года, будут официальными оплачиваемыми выходными для всех сотрудников частного сектора в ОАЭ","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Это связано с празднованием 55-го Дня единства (Eid Al Etihad)","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Министерство поздравило руководство и жителей страны с этим событием","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}
